def reverse_string(s):
    l = list(s)
    n = len(l)
    for i in range(n // 2):
        temp = l[i]
        l[i] = l[n - 1 - i]
        l[n - 1 - i] = temp
    r = ""
    for j in l:
        r += j
    return r
